IF(OR(ISNULL(Lead_Enrichment_Data_Date__c),AND(ISBLANK(MLS_ID__c), ISBLANK(Office_Name__c),ISBLANK(MLS_System__c), BLANKVALUE(Years_of_Experience__c,0)=0,Historical_Transaction_Count__c=0)),"",
